messages:
Maya: Heads-up — planning a schema migration for orders.payment_metadata. Need to lock a gated slot for the migration + backfill. Thinking Saturday 04:00 UTC (low traffic). Who can own deploy and rollback?
TJ: I can own the deploy if Sam can cover smoke checks/monitoring. ETA for the backfill looks ~90–120m on dedicated pool (depends on parallelism).
Elaine: I’m out Fri night but OK for Sat 04:00 UTC. Can we limit parallelism to avoid IO spikes? +1 to TJ as deploy owner.
Sam: I can do smoke + health dashboard runbook. Quick checklist I’ll run after cutover:
- check replication lag < 1s
- run `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE payment_metadata IS NULL;` (should be 0 for new rows)
- synthetic flow: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/orders -d '{"amount":1,"pm":{}}'` and ensure 200 & correct metadata
- tail app logs for 5m and watch 5xx rate
Maya: Good checklist. Also: dual-write window should be enabled for 15m after cutover to catch stragglers, then switch to single-source. Feature-flag gating: feature.paymeta_migration = canary -> everyone
TJ: Rollback plan summarized:
1) toggle feature.paymeta_migration back to old behavior (feature flag) -> stops writes to new column
2) re-enable old writer job (if we disabled it)
3) run quick revert migration: `rails db:migrate:down VERSION=20260302123456` (dry-run first locally)
4) if backfill partially ran, run compensating job that marks rows as migrated=false and let workers reconcile
Elaine: I’ll handle the feature flag toggle (I have console creds). I’ll also throttle backfill parallelism to 6 workers.
Sam: I’ll own the smoke dashboard during the window. I’ll prepare an alert: orders.payment_metadata-null-rate > 0.1% -> pager to eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: https://deploys.redwood/example/12345 — window Sat 2026-04-04 04:00 UTC. Creator: TJ. :rocket:
Maya: Thanks team. TJ please post a final checklist 1hr before and ping #oncall if we want rotational pager coverage. Sam, put short runbook snippet in the thread so SRE can follow.
TJ: Will do. Final checklist I’ll post at 03:00 UTC Sat. Assigning deploy owner -> TJ, smoke -> Sam, flag toggle -> Elaine. :thumbsup:
Sam: Pasting quick runbook snippet here for SRE copy/paste:
```
1) At cutover: monitor `pg_stat_replication` and app 5xx rate
2) Run `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE payment_metadata IS NULL;` every 10m
3) If 5xx spike > 0.5% for 10m -> rollback feature flag and notify deploy owner
4) If replication lag > 5s -> pause backfill and escalate to DB infra
```
Maya: perfect. locking the slot now. Thanks.
